name: Google Classroom
description: Google Classroom organizes permitted courses, coursework, due dates, and published learning materials for education users.
agentUseSummary: Connect one requesting user through Relay-owned Google OAuth with the exact courses.readonly, coursework.me.readonly, and courseworkmaterials.readonly scopes. Four wrappers read the first twenty-five permitted courses, one explicit course, the first twenty-five newest coursework posts, or the first twenty-five newest learning-material posts. Relay blocks rosters, profiles, student work, grades, guardians, writes, delegation, previews, exports, pagination, raw tools, and other users.

capabilities.label: List permitted courses
capabilities.description: Read up to twenty-five courses visible to the requesting user.

capabilities.label: Review coursework
capabilities.description: Read up to twenty-five newest coursework posts and due dates.

capabilities.label: Review learning materials
capabilities.description: Read up to twenty-five newest material posts with safe attachment links.

allowed.label: List my Classroom courses
allowed.description: Read up to twenty-five courses the requesting user may view.

allowed.label: List Classroom coursework
allowed.description: Read up to twenty-five newest coursework posts for an explicit course.

allowed.label: List Classroom materials
allowed.description: Read up to twenty-five newest learning-material posts for an explicit course.

blocked.label: Access Classroom people
blocked.description: Rosters, profiles, emails, photos, invitations, guardians, and individual student IDs are blocked.

blocked.label: Access student work or grades
blocked.description: Student submissions, responses, attachments, histories, rubrics, gradebooks, and grades are blocked.

blocked.label: Mutate or administer Classroom
blocked.description: Creates, updates, deletes, grading, turn-in, delegation, impersonation, and administration are blocked.

blocked.label: Use preview or raw Classroom access
blocked.description: Preview APIs, announcements, raw tools, exports, page tokens, automatic pagination, retries, and polling are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Read only
approvalProfiles.description: Four requesting-user reads run automatically with a twenty-five item cap while people data, student work, grades, writes, preview APIs, raw access, and pagination remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The exact scopes, requesting-user boundary, twenty-five item cap, privacy redaction, first-page-only, and no-write boundaries remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts four requesting-user Classroom reads and attaches encrypted OAuth tokens server-side.
Relay mounts four requesting-user Classroom reads and attaches encrypted OAuth tokens server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay must enable Classroom API, configure and verify the exact three sensitive read-only scopes, satisfy Google and any Workspace for Education administrator requirements, configure Railway staging credentials, and authorize an acceptance account. Those provider-console and environment actions are outside this worker task.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task, configure the canonical Railway callback, exact scopes, consent verification, administrator access where required, and staging credentials, then verify requesting-user binding, privacy redaction, four wrappers, refresh, rotation, revocation, disconnect, and quota/error mapping.

evidence.supports: Google documents requesting-user permitted course listing, the courses.readonly scope, page size, and page tokens Relay does not follow.
Google documents explicit permitted-course reads and the previewVersion parameter Relay blocks.

Google documents requester-visible material posts, newest-first ordering, page size, and the courseworkmaterials.readonly scope.
